summary: Improves IPv6 Duplicate Address Detection so it can reliably tell when a node's own probe has been looped back to it, a case that otherwise causes false duplicate-address failures. It lets a node recognize its own probe and avoid wrongly giving up an address. It builds on RFC 4862.

eli5.summary: Before using a name tag, you shout the name to see if anyone else has it. Sometimes your own echo comes back and fools you. This adds a trick to recognize your own echo.
